subject: [PATCH 22/60] mm/mempolicy: don't NUMA-hint folios outside common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses NUMA-hinting issues in the Linux kernel's memory policy module. Specifically, it prevents the NUMA balancing scanner from injecting hint faults and migrating folios outside the common memory pool (N_MEMORY_COMMON). The patch converts the zone device check to a common memory check, which includes the zone device check explicitly.
